capabilities: Insert text and tag search results into the active note
Extract a configurable number of characters before and after each match
Re-run the command on a {{ }} line to refresh results
Attach hotkeys to the plugin commands
disambiguation: Not a search panel replacement; it expands a {{ }} placeholder in the current note with matched text.
extras: Install instructions assume manual placement of files in the vault's plugins folder and require Obsidian v0.9.7+.
intentEvidence: This is plugin is based on the code of mrj-text-expand, it inserts the found results on the note you're working on.
motivation: The README says only that it is based on the code of mrj-text-expand and inserts found results into the note being worked on; no further motivation is stated.
problem: Obsidian search only shows results in the search panel; there is no built-in way to write matching text with surrounding context directly into a note.

relations.evidence: This is plugin is based on the code of mrj-text-expand

summary: Search tool that inserts text or tag search results, with surrounding context characters, into the active note at the cursor.
